4881-5396-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5396-6909-8198.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Carnage to become an Elf until end of turn
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

1169-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1169-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1839-7841-8089.description:
Activate Kuro by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

3587-5166--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Boros Reckoner to take damage.
3587-5166--86.description:
Cause Boros Reckoner to take damage by any method.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-5662--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-5662--5--195.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3480-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3151-3457-7791.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Elvish Archdruid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat.

997-1619-4605-5542-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1061-5775-7679.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
You have the city's blessing.
1061-5775-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping the creature you want to blink, saddling Fortune.
Declare Fortune as an attacker, attacking a player who cannot kill it in combat.
When Fortune attacks, it triggers, creating a delayed triggered ability.
At end of combat, Fortune's delayed triggered ability resolves, blinking it and Recruiter of the Guard.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4215-5795.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken green creature.
2034-4215-5795.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the green creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-3723-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-5089-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

109-232-1235-4477.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1355-1369-7086.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
1355-1369-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Sanctum Weaver's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Sanctum Weaver's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Sanctum Weaver's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

165-1069-5499-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-5499-6968.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-3761.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-3761.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Arcbound Crusher trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Arcbound Crusher trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

1850-5412-6701.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5412-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1074-4222-4474.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

869-1987-4423-5139.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2743-4483-5143.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-4483-5143.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2079-2457-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

654-2438-5222-6644.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

394-1445-2438-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-2438-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2018-5315-5570.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2992-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Living Lightning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Living Lightning, adding {B}.
When Living Lightning dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-2073-4009-4139.description:
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Mox Opal, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

549-1102-1636-4186.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
549-1102-1636-4186.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

871-1299-4050-4399-5105.description:
Cast Expedition Envoy by paying {W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Whenever Expedition Envoy enters the battlefield, it and Ondu Cleric triggers, causing you to gain at least two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Expedition Envoy and the Soldier token, adding {1}{W}.
Whenever Expedition Envoy dies, Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Expedition Envoy from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

231-1361-4067-4754.description:
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Razortide Bridge, untapping Ancient Den.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Ancient Den from the battlefield to your hand, returning Razortide Bridge from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Ancient Den, untapping any applicable permanent.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Razortide Bridge from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

401-4050-4242.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
401-4050-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {1}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Decaying Soil.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2882-4009-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4009-4675-4694.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying {0}.
Mox Opal enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6-3088-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-3088-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-3088-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
